    Access roads programs

    On this page

          The access road programs provide for the construction, improvement or maintenance of roads serving new or expanding airports, economic development sites, recreational and historic sites.

          Economic Development Access Program

          The Economic Development Access (EDA) Program provides funding to assist local governments with the design and/or construction of new access roads or the improvement of existing access roads to qualifying development sites. 

          EDA is a State funded program administered by the Virginia Department of Transportation under the authority of § 33.2-1509 (effective Oct. 1, 2014) of the Code of Virginia. 

          • Economic Development Access Fund Policy (revision)
          • Economic Development Access checklist
          • Economic Development Access Program guide
          • Economic Development Access Project Coordination Form

          Airport Access Program

          The Airport Access Program provides funding to assist local governments with the design and construction of new access roads or the improvement of existing access roads to licensed, public-use airports.

          Airport Access is a State funded program administered by the Virginia Department of Transportation under the authority of § 33.2-1509 (effective Oct. 1, 2014) of the Code of Virginia. 

          • Airport Access Fund policy (Oct. 1, 2014)
          • Airport Access Program guide (Oct 1, 2014)
          • Airport Access Program checklist
          • Airport Access Project Coordination Form

          Recreational Access Program

          The Recreational Access Program provides funding to assist local governments with the design and construction of new access roads and bikeways or the improvement of existing access roads to recreational areas or historic sites.

          Recreational Access is a State funded program administered by the Virginia Department of Transportation under the authority of § 33.2-1510 (effective Oct. 1, 2014) of the Code of Virginia. 

          • Recreational Access checklist
          • Recreational Access guide (Oct. 1, 2014)
          • Recreational Access Fund policy (Oct. 1, 2014)
          • Recreational Access Project Coordination Form

          Tools

          The Access Roads Program Dashboard is an interactive Power BI report which displays project data for all approved Access Program projects, from year 2000 to today. The report allows users to visualize the impact that the Economic Development, Recreational, and Airport Access programs have had across the Commonwealth.

          Last updated: October 15, 2026
